elements.name: text-2
elements.text: Chandrayaan-3 terrain reconstruction  |  Evidence snapshot: 9 Nov 2026

Profile	What changes	Interpretation
Strict / relaxed diagnostic	Camera gate bypassed; matching filters retained	0.55% / 4.12% trial-1 pixels
Uber relaxed	Uniqueness 0–2; LR up to 16 px; weaker masks	30.1%; suspect matches
No checks	External LR off; internal 512 px; weak mesh limits	85.5%; spikes / sky geometry
Wide window	21 × 21 matching block	60.7%; gross mismatch
Row-adjusted	Fit vertical warp on 80% of features	45.0%; changed camera model
Tighter row-adjusted	Restore LR, uniqueness, speckle, mesh gates	25.1% / 19.1%; still modified

elements.name: text-4
elements.text: “No checks” means most rejection disabled; it does not mean unconstrained or validated
